caption: The video captures a room corner where large interlocking toy blocks form standing structures on a wooden floor, beside a folding table of blocks and a partly visible neon sign. Over time, the tall white arched tower at the back-left steadily slumps downward, its curved silhouette sinking into a low mound against the wall. At the same time, the stepped blue tower on the right collapses progressively, shrinking from a multi-level column into a short heap. The central pile of loose multicolored blocks spreads and flattens as a vertical dark-blue cluster disperses into the broader heap. The remaining upright pieces, including the dark-blue wall, yellow and blue hollow cubes, orange base, and white cube, hold their positions with only minor surface shifts. Foreground mats, the table, the window, and the sign keep a fixed framing. The block structures are the only elements visibly changing.
